summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of administrative formalities for its previously announced acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation. The filing confirms registration of the share capital increase executed on 20 August 2026, resulting in share capital of EUR 7,509,582,970 comprising 15,019,165,940 ordinary shares. This is a routine post-closing regulatory update, not a new special situation event. No deal terms or new strategic actions are disclosed in this filing. The reference is to prior disclosures dated 3 February, 23 April, 5 August, and 20 August 2026.
